claims.time_semantics: dimensionless continuous time of the asynchronous stochastic MaBoSS dynamics, every transition rate 1; not calibrated to hours or days, not a count of Boolean updates
claims.screenability_note: transient or whole-state differences are not screenability (docs/stage4b_direct_admission.md, owner decision 6); this output does not license a screen
claims.intervals: position bars are empirical quantiles across trajectories, not confidence intervals; *_ci_* columns are percentile bootstraps over trajectories treated as exchangeable

claim_ceiling.statement: simulated first-switch order and frequencies in dimensionless MaBoSS time against a matched control, conditional on the model's rules and the stated starting ensemble

validation_level.validated: event reconstruction from tick occupancies against the installed MaBoSS backend (docs/perturbation_cascade/README.md, Stage A)
validation_level.not_validated: biological timing, causal order and experimental response; no ADOC measurement is compared

spec.name: progestin_withdrawal
spec.description: progestin (MPA) input withdrawal after hormone treatment

effects.semantics: the input is set at the perturbation boundary and held for the whole perturbed phase, as a protocol step would

starting_state.init_horizon_semantics: dimensionless MaBoSS relative time; not calibrated to hours or days
starting_state.lineage_continuations: each lineage phase continues from its parent by the protocol's own registered continuation (protocol_continuation)

tracked_nodes.note: events.tsv covers every node the run reports (every non-internal node). A tracked node the start does not carry begins from the condition cfg, and its t = 0 state is read from the first tick window, or the run is refused if that window is fractional

perturbation_boundary: t = 0 of the perturbed phase; both arms start from the same sampled terminal state of the start protocol; input values and interventions are held for the whole phase
unchanged: every input and every intervention active at the end of the start protocol stays active in both arms unless the spec changes it

simulation.seed_scheme: per-trajectory seed k = SeedSequence(master_seed).generate_state(n, uint32)[k] mod (2**31 - 2) + 1, distinct by check; initial state k drawn by numpy.random.default_rng(SeedSequence([master_seed, 1])).choice over the projected start distribution; arms share seed k and initial state k
simulation.random_generator: MaBoSS default pseudorandom generator (Rand48; use_physrandgen FALSE)
simulation.independence: initial states i.i.d. by construction; event streams from distinct spread seeds, not proven independent
simulation.horizon_semantics: dimensionless MaBoSS relative time; observation stops at the horizon and later switches are censored

event_definition.first_switch: first departure of the node from its state at the perturbation boundary (t = 0), read off single-trajectory tick occupancies (dt_adoc.cascade.events); exact when the window holds one switch
event_definition.n_switches_min: minimum number of switches consistent with the tick occupancies; a lower bound
event_definition.net_change: final state at the horizon differs from the starting state
event_definition.transient_return: switched at least twice and ended in the starting state
event_definition.rule_disagrees_at_horizon: the node's executed rule calls for a different value in the final state: still at risk, so a missing switch is censored
event_definition.categories_note: categories are read off n_switches_min, a lower bound: net_change_n_switches_min_1 is consistent with one switch, not proof of one; a fractional window can hide out-and-back pairs. Net change, whole windows and first-switch windows are exact

definitions.absolute_time: reconstructed MaBoSS relative time of the node's first switch (exact when its window held one switch, otherwise an upper bound within that window) after the perturbation boundary (t = 0); dimensionless continuous MaBoSS time with every transition rate 1, not hours and not a count of Boolean updates
definitions.normalized_rank: (r - 1) / (m - 1): r = rank of the node's first switch among the m nodes that switched in that trajectory (average rank on ties); undefined when m < 2
definitions.normalized_time: (t - t_first) / (t_last - t_first) over the first-switch times of the nodes that switched in that trajectory; undefined when t_last == t_first

figure.unresolved_adjacent_rule: |P(upper row first) - 0.5| < 0.1 with >= 50 trajectories where both switch in an identifiable order

diagnostics.note: control_stationary requires, in every control trajectory, that no node switched and that every node's rule is known and agrees with its value at the horizon: the start is then a fixed point of the control's rules, so every perturbed-arm switch is perturbation-associated under the model. Anything less (a switch, a disagreeing rule, an unevaluable one) makes it false
